tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: Get aggregate TradeDataHub marketplace coverage and record counts.

tools.name: list_states
tools.description: List purchasable state datasets with aggregate counts and prices.

tools.name: list_trades
tools.description: List contractor trades with aggregate record and dataset counts.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List city coverage, optionally filtered by state.

tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Search purchasable TradeDataHub datasets by state, city, trade, or product type. Returns metadata only, never paid rows.

tools.name: get_dataset_price
tools.description: Get the current price and public metadata for one dataset product ID.

tools.name: preview_dataset
tools.description: Return a masked availability preview for a city/trade or state/trade dataset. Business identities and contact values remain hidden.
